---
title: "Mechanics of Solids — Companion Site"
---

Interactive companions to the lecture material, organized by topic. Each page has the
relevant theory alongside live, adjustable visualization. This is not a replacement for the lecture notes, but rather a complement to be used interactively to build physical intuition.

:::{.callout-note}
The website and its content are brand new for this year so there may still be issues with it. I am also open to feedback.
:::

:::{.callout-caution}
Some of the live visualizations have had some of the formula modified for visual clarity. Use them for developing intuition, not verifications.  
:::

In addition, you will find the code shown during the problem tutorial.

## Problem sets
- [Helper functions](problems/00-helper_functions.qmd) - Set of helper functions (write them yourself)
- [Problem 1 to 7](problems/01-problems1_to7.qmd) - Topic 1 to 4
- [Problem 8 to 10](problems/02-problems8_to10.qmd) - Bars and beams

## Topics

1. [Voigt notation](lectures/01-voigt_notation.qmd) — Voigt notation
1. [Deviatoric / Spherical Decomposition](lectures/02-decomposition.qmd) — geometric picture of $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}=\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_{sph}+\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_{dev}$
1. [Yield Criteria](lectures/03-yield-criteria.qmd) — Von Mises vs Tresca on the π-plane
1. [Elastic Constants](lectures/04-elastic-constants.qmd) — Poisson's ratio and Lamé parameters, with intuition
1. [Plane stress/strain](lectures/05-plane-stress-strain.qmd) - Plane stress and plane strain in the Voigt notation
